table.name: torque: spark authority threshold manual
table.description: Spark retard budget before cylinder cut. RPM x requested torque. Internal ECU units (retard accumulator domain). Lower values = cylinder cuts engage sooner (more aggressive protection). Higher values = more spark retard allowed before cutting. The steep drop with RPM means cuts happen faster at high RPM where spark retard is less effective.

table.name: torque: spark retard budget IPS
table.description: Spark retard budget before cylinder cut — IPS variant. Same internal units as manual.

table.name: torque: limit factor manual
table.description: Torque AND load limit factor (RPM x load) — manual. Stored as (signed_val XOR 0x8000). Effective = (raw ^ 0x8000) / 100, multiplied with coolant limit. This is the primary load-limiting table — higher values = more reduction at that RPM/load cell.

table.name: torque: limit factor IPS
table.description: Torque AND load limit factor (RPM x load) — IPS. Same encoding as manual variant.

table.name: torque: reduction scaler manual
table.description: Torque reduction scaler — manual. Load x torque input → multiplier applied to the 16×16 limit factor table output. Effective multiplier = raw / 100 (0.6× to 10×). Higher values = more torque reduction. Primary purpose: scales spark retard magnitude by engine load.

table.name: torque: reduction scaler IPS
table.description: Torque reduction scaler — IPS. Same function as manual variant.

table.name: torque: torque to load
table.description: Torque-to-load conversion (Nm → mg/stroke). Indexed by RPM x requested torque. Data = cylinder air mass required.

table.name: torque: temp compensation
table.description: Torque limit temperature compensation

table.name: revlimit: speedbase manual tour
table.description: Base rev limit (manual, tour mode) — coolant temp x time from start

table.name: revlimit: speedbase manual sport
table.description: Base rev limit (manual, sport mode)

table.name: revlimit: speedbase IPS tour
table.description: Base rev limit (IPS, tour mode)

table.name: revlimit: speedbase IPS sport
table.description: Base rev limit (IPS, sport mode)

table.name: revlimit: trim per gear
table.description: Rev limit trim per gear (added to base)

table.name: revlimit: cold start RPM envelope
table.description: Cold start rev limit envelope

table.name: fuel: lambda trim (base)
table.description: Lambda trim — subtracted from commanded lambda when O2 feedback active. Throttle/load x RPM/25. Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: lambda trim (alt)
table.description: Lambda trim alternate — used for bank 2 when O2 feedback active

table.name: fuel: warmup enrichment base
table.description: Warmup/cold-start enrichment (coolant x time). Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: warmup enrichment manual
table.description: Warmup enrichment (manual transmission). Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: warmup enrichment IPS
table.description: Warmup enrichment (IPS transmission). Raw u16, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: coolant enrichment manual
table.description: Coolant temperature enrichment factor (manual). Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: coolant enrichment IPS
table.description: Coolant temperature enrichment factor (IPS). Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: power enrichment
table.description: Power enrichment factor at high load. Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: lambda modifier by RPM
table.description: Lambda modifier by RPM. Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: transient enrichment
table.description: Tip-in/tip-out transient enrichment. Raw u8, scaling TBD.

table.name: fuel: power enrich factor
table.description: Power enrichment factor. Multiplies enrichment by x/100 (100% = no extra, 125% = +25%). Active only in gears 1-4 (cal 0x73). Axis = load-derived index.

table.name: fuel: enrichment by RPM
table.description: Lambda enrichment target by engine speed (RPM/10). Raw u8 values feed into enrichment accumulation formula.

table.name: fuel: enrichment modifier
table.description: Lambda enrichment modifier — blending weight for enrichment filter. Indexed by engine speed (RPM/10).

table.name: fuel: enrichment magnitude by RPM
table.description: Lambda enrichment magnitude by RPM. Higher values = more enrichment at that RPM.

table.name: fuel: lambda correction factor
table.description: Lambda correction factor. 127=no correction, below 127=leaner, above 127=richer.

table.name: fuel: bank A enrichment
table.description: Bank A lambda enrichment (load x torque). 128 = stoich/no enrichment. Values 127-152: 127 = lean, 152 = +19% enrichment.

table.name: fuel: bank B enrichment
table.description: Bank B lambda enrichment (load x torque). 128 = stoich. Values 127-140: narrower range than Bank A.

table.name: ignition: base timing manual
table.description: Base ignition timing — manual transmission. Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load)

table.name: ignition: base timing IPS
table.description: Base ignition timing — IPS transmission. Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load)

table.name: ignition: knock safe
table.description: Knock-safe / low-octane timing (floor). Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load). More retarded — min -10.0 deg.

table.name: ignition: MBT modeled
table.description: MBT (Maximum Brake Torque) modeled timing (ceiling). Type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg (RPM x load). More advanced — min 3.5 deg.

table.name: ignition: minimum timing
table.description: Absolute minimum ignition timing. Type: u8_angle_1/4-20deg (RPM x load). Hard floor — timing is never retarded past this map, regardless of knock or torque reduction.

table.name: ignition: integrator rate A
table.description: Ignition timing integrator rate A — degrees per step vs error

table.name: ignition: integrator rate B
table.description: Ignition timing integrator rate B

table.name: ignition: integrator limit
table.description: Ignition timing integrator authority limit by RPM (angle = raw/4 - 10°)

table.name: ignition: idle advance
table.description: Idle ignition advance vs coolant temperature (type: u8_angle_1/4-10deg)

table.name: ignition: idle advance alt
table.description: Idle ignition advance alternate map

table.name: ignition: idle advance IPS
table.description: Idle ignition advance for IPS transmission

table.name: ignition: idle advance IPS alt
table.description: Idle ignition advance for IPS alternate

table.name: ignition: coolant compensation A
table.description: Coolant temperature ignition compensation A (type: u8_angle_1/4-32deg)

table.name: ignition: coolant compensation B
table.description: Coolant temperature ignition compensation B

table.description: Coolant temperature ignition compensation C

table.description: RPM-based ignition compensation

table.description: Knock retard decay rate — degrees recovered per cycle vs RPM

table.name: ignition: knock retard decay alt
table.description: Knock retard decay alternate — degrees recovered per cycle vs RPM

table.name: vvt: intake target
table.description: Intake VVT target angle (RPM x load). Max 43° advance. Narrower sport map at 0x40AA.

table.name: vvt: intake target sport
table.description: Intake VVT target — sport/active mode (smaller map, more aggressive)

table.name: vvt: exhaust target
table.description: Exhaust VVT target angle (RPM x load). Narrower sport map at 0x4122.

table.name: vvt: exhaust target sport
table.description: Exhaust VVT target — sport/active mode (smaller map, more aggressive)

table.name: vvt: intake coolant trim
table.description: Intake VVT angle trim by coolant temperature — subtracted from target when cold

table.name: vvt: exhaust coolant trim

table.description: VVT load-based compensation (manual transmission)

table.name: vvt: load compensation IPS
table.description: VVT load-based compensation (IPS transmission)

table.name: knock: window start angle
table.description: Knock detection window start angle (degrees ATDC) by RPM x load

table.name: knock: window length
table.description: Knock detection window length (crank degrees) by RPM x load. Clamped to 0x40-0x80 (16-32 deg)

table.name: pedal: map manual base
table.description: Driver demand map — manual base. Translates physical pedal % to driver demand %. No RPM axis: 100% demand = 100% of available torque at current RPM (resolved downstream via torque model).

table.name: pedal: map manual sport
table.description: Driver demand map — manual sport. More aggressive translation curve.

table.name: pedal: map IPS base
table.description: Driver demand map — IPS base.

table.name: pedal: map IPS sport
table.description: Driver demand map — IPS sport.

table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 0 — set to 0x0D as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: unlock byte 1
table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 1 — set to 0xB8 as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: unlock byte 2
table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 2 — set to 0x45 as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: unlock byte 3
table.description: ECU unlock magic byte 3 — set to 0xD4 as part of 4-byte unlock sequence

table.name: ecu: CVN
table.description: Calibration Verification Number (CRC-16 of cal data from 0x20 to end). Must match computed CRC or fault flag is set.

table.name: ecu: ROM ID
table.description: ROM identification string reported via OBD-II Mode $09 (space-padded ASCII)

table.name: fuel: pressure target
table.description: Fuel rail pressure target (mbar). 8 RPM x 5 load. 70 = 3500 mbar, 84 = 4200 mbar. u8_pressure_50mbar. Y axis = first 5 of 8 entries at 0x6180.

table.name: cooling: PWM duty cycle
table.description: Cooling fan/PWM duty cycle by temperature index

table.name: idle: target RPM base
table.description: Base idle target RPM (RPM x load)

table.name: idle: target correction
table.description: Idle target RPM correction factor

table.name: idle: target RPM by coolant A
table.description: Idle RPM target by coolant temperature (variant A)

table.name: idle: target RPM by coolant B
table.description: Idle RPM target by coolant temperature (variant B)

table.name: idle: target RPM by coolant C
table.description: Idle RPM target by coolant temperature (variant C)

table.name: idle: target RPM by coolant D
table.description: Idle RPM target by coolant temperature (variant D)

table.name: idle: RPM target curve
table.description: Idle RPM target delta (32768-x encoding). Decreases from 180 RPM at 600 RPM to 0 at 1000 RPM — reduces idle correction as RPM rises.

table.name: idle: vehicle speed compensation
table.description: Idle RPM compensation by vehicle speed

table.name: torque: load to torque
table.description: Load-to-torque conversion (mg/stroke -> Nm). Indexed by RPM x cylinder load. Output = estimated engine torque in Nm. Inverse of torque-to-load table. Peak 650 Nm at 1173 mg/stroke x 6800 RPM.

table.name: torque: max load by RPM x torque margin
table.description: MAXIMUM ENGINE LOAD (mg/stroke) by RPM x torque margin. Caps the torque-to-load conversion output — limits cylinder air mass. 780-1070 mg/stroke. INCREASE to allow more airflow/power. This is the primary load ceiling.

table.description: Drive mode CAN button index → internal mode (0=Tour, 1=Sport, 2=Track)

table.name: drivemode: throttle response gain
table.description: Throttle response gain by drive mode index (higher = more responsive). Effective gain = raw × 10.
